content.text:
Plan submitted covering all 18 rules.

**Summary of findings for the review team:**

- **Located and substantive:** LOL-CAP (§11.5, mutual damages waiver, no monetary cap found), INDEMN (§§11.1–11.4 mutual), NONCOMPETE/EXCLUSIVITY (§5.8 — runs against Harpoon, favourable to us), T4C (§12.3 AbbVie convenience right; Harpoon limited to breach/insolvency), RENEWAL (§12.1.1 royalty-term-based, no auto-renewal), GOVLAW (§13.6 Delaware + §13.7 tiered dispute/arbitration election), ASSIGN (§13.4 plus §13.2 Harpoon CoC regime), IP (§7.1), LICENSE (§5.1–5.3, 5.7 plus §3.2.3 option), AUDIT (§§6.11–6.12, runs against us), WARRANTY (§§10.1–10.5), INSURANCE (§11.6 with AbbVie self-insurance), TRANSITION (§§12.6–12.7 reversion plus §9.7).
- **Likely absent:** MFN, NOSOLICIT, LD (only late-payment interest and non-refundable milestones), MINCOMMIT.
- **Flagged for careful pagination:** the redacted carve-outs in §11.5, the arbitration scope in §13.7.3, the audit cost/frequency terms in §6.11, and the redacted reversion obligations at §§12.7.3–12.7.4.
